task: Summarize the key points of the financial meeting detailed in meeting_agenda.pdf into a Word (.docx) file named 'meeting_summary.docx'. query_sentence: Summarize the main points from the financial meeting agenda PDF into a Word file, focusing on participants, the schedule, and discussion topics.
